task: Redesenho da auditoria da Vicky por usuário em formato de chat

behavior.users: Unique user, latest interaction descending; 25 users/page; avatars, public name, last time, channels and counts; no message previews.
behavior.history: Selected user, all matching channels; newest batch of 20 interactions displayed in chronological order; cursor-based progressive older loading and ID snapshot.
behavior.filters: Name or exact user ID; 7/30/90 days; channel; all versus non-completed interactions. Processing is labeled correctly, not called failure.
behavior.execution_links: Legacy execucao links locate the user and batch; compatible filters preserved; target outside period can still open.
behavior.privacy: Existing require_admin guard unchanged. Each opened execution is recorded transactionally before fetching message content; failed audit write prevents access. Message content is HTML escaped. private/no-store response headers.
behavior.retention: Missing retained content is identified rather than reconstructed.
behavior.details: Readable status badges; collapsed model, tokens, latency, errors, sanitized tool arguments/results and permalink.
behavior.accessibility: Keyboard focus retained on replacement older control or final status; modified clicks preserve normal new-tab navigation; live loading/error status; responsive mobile stacking.
behavior.unchanged: Agent response generation, RAG, channel delivery and proactive interactions. Existing unrelated desafios changes preserved.

verification.baseline_and_candidate_hashes: matched before backup and publish; live files equal candidate
verification.native_isolation: Temporary PostgreSQL tables cloned WITH NO DATA from production column types; all fixture and audit writes rolled back. Matching result types avoids prepared-plan invalidation caused by minimal-schema fixtures during early validation.

browser_handler_tests.boundary: Actual audit.js runs in VM; unavailable DOMParser and fetch boundaries doubled. Real browser progressive loading verified separately.
